pdmat bernsteinTable

Documents / pdmat / bernsteinTable

Purpose

Section titled “Purpose”

Inspect coefficient-backed pdmat local Bernstein data as a MATLAB table.

Syntax

Section titled “Syntax”

Arguments

Section titled “Arguments”
ArgumentDescription
AA coefficient-backed pdmat object.
cellSubsPhysical-cell subscript to inspect, such as 1 for a one-parameter grid or [1 1] for a tensor grid.
"oneLine"Compact mode that returns one row per selected physical cell with a readable Bernstein expression.

Output

Section titled “Output”

T is a MATLAB table with variables:

VariableMeaning
TermIndexRow number in the expanded coefficient table.
CellSubscriptPhysical cell subscript.
CoeffSubscriptExpanded coefficient-grid subscript.
LocalIndexLocal Bernstein label.
BasisLocal basis factor text.
IsPhysicalNodeWhether the coefficient lies on a physical grid node.
ValueStored numeric matrix coefficient.

Public formulas use the forward coordinate and the normalized factors

The diagnostic uses the same public alpha name. Its rows are (1-alpha)^2, 2(1-alpha)alpha, and alpha^2 in forward-coordinate order. For multiple parameters, the basis text is the tensor product of the corresponding one-parameter factors.

Examples

Section titled “Examples”

Compact expression for one cell

Section titled “Compact expression for one cell”

Use "oneLine" when the goal is to see the Bernstein expression rather than the full metadata table.

The compact expression is useful for quick coefficient checks in the MATLAB Command Window and reads directly in the public forward coordinate.

Full degree-two metadata

Section titled “Full degree-two metadata”

The middle row is not a physical grid node for degree two; it is the middle Bernstein coefficient for the single physical cell.

Tensor-grid label order

Section titled “Tensor-grid label order”

The tensor-grid order matches A.lbls() and is the same order used by coefficient algebra and pdlmi assembly.

Validation And Errors

Section titled “Validation And Errors”
  • Function-only objects without Bernstein coefficient evidence raise pdmat:FunctionOnlyBernsteinTable when calling bernsteinTable; backend degree elevation instead raises pdbase:MissingCoefficientEvidence.
  • Invalid cell subscripts raise pdbase:InvalidCellSubs.
  • Unknown display modes, such as "wide", raise pdmat:InvalidBernsteinTableInput.
